categories.main_business_segments: Chengdu Guibao Science & Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the new materials industry, focusing on the research, production, and sales of high-end organosilicon sealants, hot melt adhesives, silane coupling agents, and silicon-carbon anode materials. Its product portfolio serves key sectors including construction, automotive manufacturing, new energy, energy conservation, environmental protection, and next-generation information technology. The company also engages in chemical product manufacturing and related equipment production through its subsidiaries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies in organosilicon sealants with over 26 years of R&D experience, supported by a strong patent portfolio including hundreds of patents in China, the US, and Japan. It employs advanced production methods such as fully automated production lines, intelligent warehouses, and digital manufacturing systems. Key technologies include high-performance organosilicon sealants, polyurethane sealants, silane-modified polyethers, hot melt adhesives, epoxy and acrylic adhesives, and silicon-carbon anode materials for lithium-ion batteries. The company maintains national-level innovation platforms and collaborates extensively with universities and research institutes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's products serve a broad range of customers in industries such as construction (building curtain walls, energy-efficient doors and windows, prefabricated buildings), automotive (vehicle lighting, main vehicle assembly), electronics and electrical appliances, new energy (photovoltaics, lithium batteries), power and environmental protection, and consumer goods (labels, hygiene products). Major customers include leading enterprises like BYD, CATL, ZTE, DJI, and top photovoltaic companies such as LONGi and Tongwei. The company also exports to over 60 countries including India, Brazil, South Korea, Indonesia, the US, and Russia.
categories.geographic_coverage: Chengdu Guibao operates primarily in China with major production bases in Sichuan (Chengdu, Meishan), Jiangsu (Nantong), Anhui (Ma'anshan), Shanghai, and other regions. It is expanding its presence in the Yangtze River Delta with a new R&D and production center in Shanghai. The company has a global sales network covering Asia, Europe, and South America, with exports to more than 60 countries and regions worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the production and sales of high-end chemical materials such as organosilicon sealants, adhesives, and battery materials. It sources raw materials like organosilicon polymers and petroleum-based polymers from upstream suppliers and provides value-added products to downstream industries including construction, automotive, electronics, and new energy sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes continuous technological innovation, digital transformation, and capacity expansion. It invests heavily in R&D with over 100 projects annually and maintains multiple national and provincial innovation platforms. Key R&D directions include high-performance organosilicon sealants, environmentally friendly adhesives, silicon-carbon anode materials for lithium batteries, and advanced materials for photovoltaics and automotive applications. The company also pursues international collaboration and aims to develop high value-added products to support national strategic industries.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of chemical products including organosilicon sealants, hot melt adhesives, silane coupling agents, and silicon-carbon anode materials. The company employs a mixed sales model combining direct sales, distribution channels, and e-commerce platforms. It also earns investment income from equity holdings and financial asset management. The majority of revenue comes from product sales to industrial and construction customers domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Chengdu Guibao is a leading player and industry leader in China's organosilicon sealant market, recognized as a national manufacturing champion and a top 10 global organosilicon company. It holds a dominant market position with strong brand recognition and technological leadership. The company competes with both domestic and international chemical and adhesive manufacturers, leveraging its scale, innovation, and comprehensive product portfolio to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported consolidated revenue of approximately RMB 3.16 billion, representing a 21.24% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 237.5 million, a 24.63% decrease due to raw material price declines and market competition. It operates with total assets exceeding RMB 4 billion and equity of RMB 2.56 billion. The company has demonstrated strong growth in sales volume (34.38% increase) and maintains high capacity utilization rates above 95% for key products. It has steadily expanded production capacity and workforce, with over 1,865 employees including 263 R&D personnel.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through advanced proprietary technologies, a broad and high-quality product portfolio, and strong brand reputation including the 'Guibao' trademark recognized as a China well-known brand. It offers high-performance, environmentally friendly, and specialized adhesive materials tailored for strategic industries such as construction, automotive, photovoltaics, and lithium batteries. Its integrated digital manufacturing and quality control systems ensure product reliability and cost efficiency, while its extensive R&D capabilities enable rapid innovation and import substitution of high-end products.
